004.text: The skies above Gensokyo have been cleared.

007.name: Marisa
007.text: Much better than that dreary weather.

009.name: Marisa
009.text: I should go out to collect some mushrooms today.

013.name: Sakuya
013.text:
I've been told there are some books missing
			from Miss Patchouli's library.

014.name: Marisa
014.text: ... Oh my, that's terrible. Send her my condolences.

015.name: Sakuya
015.text:
You wouldn't happen to know what happened to them,
			do you?

019.name: Sakuya
019.text: Miss Patchouli requests you go to the basement of the mansion.

021.name: Sakuya
021.text: She say's she'll fire a giant laser at your house.

022.name: Marisa
022.text: I will go to the basement.

026.name: Marisa
026.text: Looks like I've been given a sidequest..

029.text:
Congratulations!
			Start the Extra Stage to continue the story.
